title: No Silktouch Warn
description:
This mod warns you when you use a non-silktouch-netherite or diamond pickaxe to mine an enderchest.

The warning is customizable.
body:
A fully customizable mod to warn you when you try to mine your enderchest with your non-silktouch pickaxe (only diamond and netherite).

There are some commands:

/enderchestwarning set/get/enable/disable

Use set to write a string that will be your warning.
